item.title: RTT: Rif. 6267_All. 4 - Host–Microbiota Interactions in Pigs: Nutritional Strategies to Promote Gut Health (Univ. BOLOGNA)
item.description:
Deadline: 2026-12-03 23:59
Institution: Univ. BOLOGNA, Bologna
Field: Agriculture and veterinary science / 07/AGRI-09 Scienze e tecnologie animali

The research activity will focus on animal nutrition and feeding, with particular emphasis on host–microbiota interactions in pigs. The effects of different nutritional strategies will be evaluated, including the use of bioactive compounds, especially during the pre- and post-weaning phases. To elucidate their mechanisms of action, parameters related to the integrity and maturation of the intestinal mucosa will be assessed, together with the composition and development of the host gut microbiota. The research will adopt an integrated approach based on omics technologies, including transcriptomics, metagenomics, and metabolomics with data integration approaches using bioinformatics and…

item.title: RTT: Rif. 6269_All. 2 - Microbiomes for agroecosystems sustainability (Univ. BOLOGNA)
item.description:
Deadline: 2026-12-03 23:59
Institution: Univ. BOLOGNA, Bologna
Field: Agriculture and veterinary science / 07/AGRI-08 Microbiologia agraria, alimentare e ambientale

The research activities will focus on the ecology, diversity, and functions of microbiomes associated with animals, plants, soil, and agroecosystems, with particular attention to interactions among microorganisms, hosts, and the environment. Microbial communities and their functional potential will be characterized, assessing the effects of environmental, nutritional, and anthropogenic factors, including xenobiotics and agricultural practices. Microbiomes will be investigated through metagenomic approaches and culture-dependent techniques. item.title: RTT: Ref. 6286_All. 7 - Development of agronomic techniques for low-input production (integrated and organic) for field crops (Univ. BOLOGNA)
item.description:
Deadline: 2026-12-03 23:59
Institution: Univ. BOLOGNA, Bologna
Field: Agriculture and veterinary science / 07/AGRI-02 Agronomia e sistemi colturali erbacei e ortofloricoli

The planned activities of the project will include: • the Identification of optimized agronomic management for growing cereals and pulses under organic or low-input farming, with valorization of qualitative characteristics of final products; • the definition and set-up of innovative agro-ecological techniques for growing major and minor cereals, pulses and field crops; • Set-up of agro-ecologic techniques for the improvement of resilience and sustainability of cropping systems, through improved ecosystem services for defense and nutrition of crops.

item.title: RTT: Ref. 6346 - Consumer behaviour and food choices: preference analysis, modelling and intervention evaluation for food system sustainability (Univ. BOLOGNA)
item.description:
Deadline: 2026-12-03 23:59
Institution: Univ. BOLOGNA, Bologna
Field: Agriculture and veterinary science / 07/AGRI-01 Economia agraria, alimentare ed estimo rurale

The project will investigate the economic, behavioural and social determinants of decision-making in agri-food systems, focusing on food purchasing, consumption and management. The research will examine the role of preferences, habits, social norms, information and food environments, exploring willingness to pay for quality and sustainability attributes, preference heterogeneity, and the gap between stated intentions and actual behaviour. The analysis may extend to farmers’ decisions, including production choices, adoption of sustainable practices and responses to economic and institutional incentives.
